the 1.9 rewrite of aiStep is in what tick_dragon calls: the phase-driven flight is tick_dragon_flight's, gated at 1.9 (dragon.rs:213), the neck and the part sizes are dragon_parts', gated at 1.9 (dragon.rs:310-311, 331); the history's sample is record's (reviewed at 1.9.4); the rest (sounds, crystals, hurt and knockback, client lerp) tick_dragon does not mirror

the 1.11 change is the parts' old positions (subEntities captured before they move) and locals renamed, which dragon_parts takes at its 1.11 gate (dragon.rs:364); move gains MoverType.SELF, the same move
the 1.14 changes are the flight's (tick_dragon_flight's 1.14 gate, dragon.rs:219) and the parts' (part_size's 1.14 gate, dragon.rs:318); x/y/z become getters of the same fields
the 1.15 change in the parts is dragon_parts' 1.15 gate (dragon.rs:334); the rest reads x, y, z through getX(), getY(), getZ(), the same values

the 1.17 changes in the flight (the kept box, Mth.sqrt to Math.sqrt, the turn) are tick_dragon_flight's 1.17 gates (dragon.rs:148, 229, 249); yRot through setYRot(Mth.wrapDegrees(getYRot())) is the wrap tick_dragon does first; the flap and growl sounds move to processFlappingMovement, which it does not mirror
the 1.18.2 change is the turn computed in float, tick_dragon_flight's 1.18.2 gate (dragon.rs:255); the rest is locals renamed
1.20 adds the server's dragonFight lookup and reads the level through level(); the flight and the parts only rename locals, the same values
1.20.2 moves the client's lerp into lerpPositionAndRotationStep, which tick_dragon (the server's AI) does not mirror; the flight and the parts only rename locals
1.21 is the server's wing knockback and hurt (`level() instanceof ServerLevel`), which tick_dragon does not mirror (dragon_wing_pushes does, with its own gate), and locals renamed in the parts

1.21.2 moves the history into DragonFlightHistory (record, reviewed equivalent at 1.21.2), passes the ServerLevel to the phase, and changes the parts' angles, dragon_parts' 1.21.2 gate (dragon.rs:392); applyEffectsFromBlocks, added, is no part of the flight or the parts
1.21.5 replaces the client's lerp with interpolation.interpolate(), which tick_dragon does not mirror
26.3 drops the client's interpolation call from aiStep and tests !wasHurtRecently() for the server's wing knockback, neither of which tick_dragon mirrors

1.11.2 adds move(Vec3), which calls the unchanged move(double, double, double) with the vector's components: the same sums translated computes
1.21 adds move(Vector3f), which widens each float to double and calls the unchanged move(double, double, double): the same sums for the same offset

1.14.4 adds expandTowards(Vec3), which calls the unchanged expandTowards(double, double, double) with the vector's components: a negative component lowers the minimum, a positive one raises the maximum, through the ordering constructor, as expand_towards does

AABB#contract is added in 1.11; contract's only callers are shulker_box.rs's delta_bounds and legacy_push, and a shulker box exists only from 1.11: simulateVersionedShulkerBoxTick refuses a release before 1.11 (simulate_versioned_shulker_box_tick, napi_api.rs:7951; 1.10.2 BlockEntity.java:243-263 registers none), and the push entries take a shulker state such a tick gives; no 1.10.2 world has a shulker box to push with, so 1.10.2 never reaches it

1.9.4 adds inflate(double), which calls the unchanged inflate(double, double, double) with the amount on each axis; inflate mirrors inflate(double, double, double): the minimum less and the maximum plus the amount, through the ordering constructor

1.8.8's deflate(d, e, f) is new AABB(minX + d, ..., maxX - d, ...) through the ordering constructor (1.8.8 AABB.java:23-29); 1.9.4's deflate(double) is inflate(-d): minX - (-d) and maxX + (-d), which IEEE subtraction and addition of a negated value give bit for bit as minX + d and maxX - d; deflate is inflate of the negated amount, the same on both sides

AABB#intersect is added in 1.11; intersect's only caller is piston.rs's push (piston.rs:386), which push_in_turn calls only from 1.11: before it goes to push_before_1_9 or push_before_1_11 (piston.rs:258-262, `else if !release.at_least(1, 11, 0)`), so 1.10.2 never reaches it

AABB.contains(Vec3) takes the lower faces in from 1.13 (1.12.2 strict on all six, 1.13.2 contains(double, double, double)); every engine caller that runs before 1.13 avoids it: the arrow's in-ground test spells the strict 1.12 comparison itself before 1.13 (arrow_tick, projectile.rs:960-970), clip_block sends releases before 1.13 to clip_block_legacy (projectile.rs:2873), legacy_shapes.rs's grid (122) runs only on 1.13, collide_over_grid (collision.rs:446) is VoxelShape.collideX, run with voxel shapes only from 1.13 (simulation.rs:4215), the boat's eye test (simulation.rs:1533) only on 1.16 - 1.16.1, and collided_along_vector only from 1.21.5 (blocks_inside_moves, simulation.rs:2754); the grid tests also ask only cell centres, never a face. So no release before 1.13 reaches it

AABB#clip(Vec3, Vec3, BlockPos) and getDirection are added in 1.13 (before, the six-face Box raycast, which projectile_hits.rs clip_box and projectile.rs clip_block_legacy mirror); clip_faces's callers run only from 1.13: clip_block returns clip_block_legacy before 1.13 (projectile.rs:2873), clip_box uses clip_segment only from 1.13 (projectile_hits.rs:997), many_hits only from 1.21.11, collided_along_vector only from 1.21.5 (blocks_inside_moves, simulation.rs:2754); so 1.12.2 never reaches it

getDirection, which clip_faces mirrors (the entering face and the fraction, each axis tested past 1.0E-7), is unchanged; 1.14.4's clip(Vec3, Vec3) drops the BlockPos offset (the engine's caller moves the boxes itself, projectile.rs:2913) and returns Optional<Vec3> instead of a HitResult, and clip(Iterable, ...) returns a BlockHitResult of the same point and face
26.1 renames the parameters and locals of clip and getDirection and makes them final; the arithmetic and the order of the axes are the same

collided_along_vector's only caller is blocks_inside_moves's per-block test, which returns before it on every release before 1.21.5 (blocks_inside_moves, simulation.rs:2754 `if !release.at_least(1, 21, 5)`); so neither side of this boundary reaches it

1.8.8's intersects(AABB) is false when arg.maxX <= minX or arg.minX >= maxX (and so on); 1.9.4's is minX < arg.maxX && maxX > arg.minX on each axis: the negation of the same test, strict on every axis as intersects is
1.10.2 adds intersects(Vec3, Vec3), the box of the two points through the unchanged intersects(double x 6); intersects(AABB), which intersects mirrors, is unchanged
1.21.6 adds intersects(BlockPos), the cell's box through the unchanged intersects(double x 6); intersects(AABB) is unchanged
